name: Vivek Kumar
title: Graphic Designer
profile: Graphic Designer with about a year of hands-on experience in brand identity, packaging, social media and marketing design. At AlgoRoot I redesigned the company logo, built a new visual identity for AlgoJob and redesigned the website with clearer hierarchy and typography. I bring a strong eye for typography, colour and layout, plus motion skills for logo animation and social content from my Dice Academy certification.

bullets: Rebuilt brand identity: redesigned the AlgoRoot logo and created a new visual identity for AlgoJob.
Redesigned the AlgoRoot website end to end, bringing clearer visual hierarchy, typography and consistency across pages.
Redesigned a 16-slide pitch deck, an investor one-pager and a four-template onboarding email system.
Revamped the UI/UX of AlgoJob's AI career platform and redesigned the AlgoVox product interface.
Worked with dev and marketing teams in an agile setup.

projects.name: VOLT 47
bullets: Built a 24-hour gym identity around one logo shape read three ways: a wedge cut at 23°, three barbell plates and a bolt in negative space, holding from a 16 px app icon to a lit shopfront sign.
Delivered logo suite, colour and type system (Anton + Space Grotesk), pattern, eight applications, a three-post social kit and an eight-second logo reveal with sound.

projects.name: CHASHNI
bullets: Created a bilingual (Devanagari + Latin) Diwali mithai brand whose box colour names the sweet inside, with print-ready packaging and dielines.
Carried one campaign line, "This one stops here", across three reels and three carousels.

projects.name: BIJLI BAZAAR
bullets: Designed nine posts for a fictional night mela, each in 4:5 and 9:16, every one solving a different layout problem inside one system of five colours, two typefaces and four type treatments.

projects.name: Watien Boutique
bullets: Identity for a luxury bag and jewellery boutique (name means "soul" in Arabic): logo, custom typography, deep green and gold palette, packaging, merchandise mockups, signage and brand presentation.

projects.name: Social Media & Poster Design
bullets: Social posts for gaming, F&B, beauty/skincare and lifestyle brands; cinematic, sport, product advertising and editorial typographic posters.
